obligations.name: admin_eyes_reactions_core_infra
obligations.description: Select reactions where the reacting user holds an admin-role workspace_membership in Test Workspace, the reaction_type is 'eyes', and the reacted message's channel is #core-infra; used to answer the user's question about which such reactions exist.
obligations.scope: Reactions by workspace-admin members with emoji 'eyes' on messages posted in the #core-infra channel of Test Workspace

task_spec.text: Identify any reactions meeting the criteria and report which ones (if any) qualify, along with the reacting admin and the reacted message.

access_plan: Use conversations.list (or users.conversations) to locate the #core-infra channel ID within Test Workspace, then users.list/users.info to determine which members hold the admin workspace_membership role. Use conversations.history on #core-infra to enumerate its messages, then reactions.get on each message to check for 'eyes' reactions and cross-reference the reacting user's admin status; confirm no reaction satisfies all three conditions simultaneously.
